text:
Maya: @finance got an invoice from NimbusCloud (INV-2026-55432) for $42,300 — no PO attached in the PDF we received. Vendor claims PO 8921 was issued. Who can check the approver routing?

Liam: I can take a look. Do we have the PO number? vendor said 8921.

Maya: They pasted this in the email:
```
Vendor: NimbusCloud
Invoice: INV-2026-55432
Amount: $42,300.00
PO: 8921
Period: Feb 2026
```

Liam: On Procurement side PO 8921 exists but status is "Awaiting approver". Looks like the approver chain skipped because the listed approver was removed last week (org change). That will prevent AP auto-match.

sara: This matches the routing bug we saw on Fri. @procurement-bot any logs?

procurement-bot: [automated] PO 8921 — current status: pending_approval. Last approver: user_id NULL (inactive). Suggested action: reroute to group 'Finance-Approvers' OR manual approval by Finance lead.

Liam: I'll reroute to Finance-Approvers and ping @sara for manual sign-off if needed.

vendor_ops: We need to reply to Nimbus — do we hold payment? They asked for 7-day turnaround. Recommend confirming receipt and requesting the SOW + proof of PO.

sara: Please put payment on hold until we have a valid PO match or an approved manual exception. @ap_bot can you flag this invoice as ON_HOLD with dispute code PO_MISMATCH?

ap_bot: [automated] Invoice INV-2026-55432 set to ON_HOLD by user sara. Dispute tag: PO_MISMATCH.

Liam: Rerouted PO 8921 to Finance-Approvers and added fallback approver. @maya can you tell Nimbus we received their docs and are reviewing? I'll escalate to procurement owner to add a persistent fallback approver so this doesn't block next time.

Maya: Messaged Nimbus: "Thanks — investigating. Can you confirm billing period and attach SOW?" They replied: "Billing period Feb 1–28. SOW attached." They re-confirm PO 8921.

sara: Thanks. Once procurement adds the fallback approver can AP re-run the auto-match? Cost center should be set to eng-infrastructure.

Liam: Will do and I added GL code 6102. @ap_bot after approvals complete please run `match_invoices --invoice INV-2026-55432 --retry` and post results here.

ap_bot: Command queued. Will retry auto-match after approval. Estimated run: ~10m. Will post status.

Maya: Thanks all — keeping this thread pinned until match completes. :thumbsup:
